knowledge:
- key_parameters: test=The test dataset, which can be a SummarizedExperiment or any (log-)normalized expression matrix ;; ref=The reference dataset containing log-expression values with sample-level labels ;; labels=A vector of labels corresponding to the columns of the reference dataset ;; assay.type.test=The assay to use from the test object (e.g., 1 or "logcounts") ;; de.method=The marker detection method; set to "wilcox" (Wilcoxon rank sum test) for single-cell references to handle low-coverage data where the median is frequently zero
- alternatives: Manual interpretation of clusters and manual marker gene definition, which SingleR automates to save time and ensure reproducibility
- when_to_use: When you have unlabelled single-cell RNA-seq data and want to automatically assign cell type labels using a high-quality, labelled reference dataset (either bulk or single-cell)
- pitfalls: Reference datasets must be normalized and log-transformed before running SingleR() ;; Default marker detection may fail for low-coverage single-cell reference data where the median is frequently zero, requiring the use of de.method="wilcox" ;; Low delta values indicate uncertain assignments (e.g., if the cell's true label does not exist in the reference), which should be filtered out using the pruned.labels field or pruneScores()

workflows.name: annotation_with_builtin_reference
workflows.intent: Annotate single-cell RNA-seq test data using a built-in reference dataset from the celldex package.
input: test_dataset.rds (unlabelled single-cell RNA-seq expression matrix or SummarizedExperiment)
reference_dataset.rds (built-in reference from celldex, e.g., HumanPrimaryCellAtlasData)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the built-in reference dataset ;; 2. Load the test dataset ;; 3. Run SingleR annotation using the reference labels ;; 4. Summarize the predicted labels.
workflows.code:
hpca.se <- HumanPrimaryCellAtlasData()
hESCs <- LaMannoBrainData('human-es')
hESCs <- hESCs[,1:100]
pred.hesc <- SingleR(test = hESCs, ref = hpca.se, assay.type.test=1, labels = hpca.se$label.main)
table(pred.hesc$labels)

workflows.name: annotation_with_single_cell_reference_and_diagnostics
workflows.intent: Annotate single-cell RNA-seq test data using a custom single-cell reference dataset, employing Wilcoxon-based marker detection and diagnostic visualizations.
input: test_dataset.rds (unlabelled single-cell RNA-seq dataset, e.g., GrunPancreasData)
reference_dataset.rds (labelled single-cell RNA-seq dataset, e.g., MuraroPancreasData)
workflows.stages: 1. Load and preprocess the single-cell reference dataset (remove unlabelled cells, normalize, and log-transform) ;; 2. Load and preprocess the test dataset (remove zero-count libraries, normalize, and log-transform) ;; 3. Run SingleR with Wilcoxon marker detection ;; 4. Plot score heatmap to inspect assignment confidence ;; 5. Plot delta distribution to evaluate label ambiguity ;; 6. Check pruned scores to identify low-quality assignments ;; 7. Plot marker expression heatmap for specific assigned labels.
workflows.code:
sceM <- MuraroPancreasData()
sceM <- sceM[,!is.na(sceM$label)]
sceM <- scrapper::normalizeRnaCounts.se(sceM)
sceG <- GrunPancreasData()
sceG <- sceG[,colSums(counts(sceG)) > 0]
sceG <- scrapper::normalizeRnaCounts.se(sceG)
pred.grun <- SingleR(test=sceG, ref=sceM, labels=sceM$label, de.method="wilcox")
table(pred.grun$labels)
plotScoreHeatmap(pred.grun)
plotDeltaDistribution(pred.grun, ncol = 3)
summary(is.na(pred.grun$pruned.labels))
plotMarkerHeatmap(pred.grun, sceG, label="beta")
